patch_list: Disable all ads and ad components

Disables the game's entire ad stack: AdMob mediation initialization and the banner, interstitial, rewarded and app-open load entry points; Meta Audience Network initialization and loads; and Amazon APS (DTB) ad requests. No ads of any form…

Disables AppsFlyer (session start and event logging), Facebook AppEvents (activation, events, purchases, user data) and DoodleBI, the game's own reporting layer and its only Firebase Analytics consumer. No usage or ad-revenue events leave…
